goal: Within one imm-run entry the run recovers by itself: both continuation hooks allow two native-operation failures before pausing, the agent applies and commits alone a deterministic preflight fix before retrying, and the packaged Loop contract states the retry rules and the remaining user stops (Spec D9, D10).

acceptance.assertion: On each Host the first and second native-operation failure under one entry token leave the run live and native tools admitted; the third pauses the run and denies native tools; a new literal entry resets the count.

The packaged imm-run contracts and BASELINE state that a literal entry needs no gate or chat confirmation, that only side-effect-free rejections are retried at most twice after rerunning preflight, that plan_changed, head_moved and claim conflicts are never retried, that a deterministic preflight fix is committed alone and listed in the manifest, and that push, PR, credentials, breaking intent revision and rework exits still stop for the user.
